name: University of Geneva
summary: Geneva's public university, beside the UN and CERN; bachelor's degrees are taught in French, a few in French and English.

handoff.label: Enrolment conditions by diploma and deadlines

ib.text: 32/42 points; six subjects in the swissuniversities pattern, three at HL including maths or a science. Psychology, ESS, Global Politics, Visual Arts and more don't count. French B2: UNIGE's French test unless exempt.

notes: Some bachelor's, such as Information Systems and Business Analytics, are taught in French and English, but the French requirement still applies.
The French test for autumn entry is held on the Monday of week 36, just before term; a narrow fail can lead to a preparatory French year instead.
For 2026 entry, applicants who need no Swiss visa had until 30 April; the 2027-28 enrolment conditions are not yet published.
